Reliable Taxi in Arth-Goldau

Arth-Goldau is much more than a railway hub between the cantons of Schwyz, Zug and Lucerne. Anyone arriving here finds themselves at the foot of the Rigi and in a region that attracts travellers from all over the world. Nova Taxi knows every street between the train station, Tierpark Goldau and the surrounding hamlets like the back of our hand.

Our base in Türlihof in Oberarth is only a few minutes from Goldau. That means short response times, especially for spontaneous bookings or delayed trains. Whether you wish to be welcomed off the InterCity after a long journey or driven to an early flight to Zurich, we are there for you.

Our Services in Arth-Goldau

Arth-Goldau station is one of the most important interchange hubs in Central Switzerland. We pick you up directly from the platform and bring you to hotels, conferences or private addresses. Tierpark Goldau is also served daily – ideal for family outings with prams or large groups.

For business travellers we offer fixed contracts at fair rates. Commuters from Walchwil, Steinen or Lauerz regularly use our service for the Zurich Airport route, which is reached in around 50 minutes.

  • Zurich Airport transfers – fixed prices on request
  • Arth-Goldau station – platform pickup possible
  • Tierpark Goldau – family-friendly trips
  • Rigi-Bahn cogwheel railway base station
  • Hotel transfers to Rigi and Schwyz
  • Corporate accounts with monthly invoicing

Why Choose Nova Taxi in Arth-Goldau

We live and work in this region. That makes the difference when roadworks divert traffic on the Axenstrasse or the Gotthard route is congested. Our drivers always choose the fastest route and communicate transparently about waiting times.

Our vehicles are regularly serviced, clean and equipped with space for luggage, bicycles or ski equipment. Payment is possible with cash, card or Twint – with no hidden surcharges.

Mobility around Arth-Goldau

The location between Lake Zug and Lake Lauerz makes Arth-Goldau an ideal starting point for excursions. From here you reach the centre of Schwyz in ten minutes, Brunnen on Lake Lucerne in fifteen minutes and Zug in around twenty minutes.

We are also available at night, when public transport thins out. Concerts at the KKL Lucerne, events in the Mythen region or rides home after a restaurant visit in Brunnen – Nova Taxi gets you home safely.

Frequently Asked Questions about Taxi Arth-Goldau

How long does a taxi take from Arth-Goldau to Zurich Airport?

The journey takes about 50 to 60 minutes depending on traffic. For international flights we recommend pickup three hours before departure.

Do you pick me up directly at the platform in Arth-Goldau station?

Yes, for a small surcharge we come right to the platform. Just provide carriage number and arrival time when booking.

What does a ride from Arth-Goldau to Tierpark Goldau cost?

The short journey is between 10 and 18 francs. On request we offer fixed prices and waiting times for families.

Are you available at night?

Yes, Nova Taxi operates 24/7. Even at 03:00 for early flights we are reachable – please book a day in advance if possible.

Can I book larger groups with you?

For groups of five or more we organise minivans or several vehicles in convoy. Please book at least twelve hours in advance.
